hunk_reviews.judgment: Renames the private bottom-sheet fixture Core import createNgModuleRef to createNgModule; this is the deprecated alias replacement, not a wait/render API change.
Renames the bottom-sheet module-creation call while retaining module type, parent injector and resulting injector. The add-on owns no ordinary bottom-sheet component implementation.
Renames the private dialog fixture Core import to createNgModule. The owned dialog spec already imports that public nondeprecated minimum API.

Renames the dialog module-creation call without changing arguments or injector use. The owned parent fixture already uses the corresponding replacement; lifetime and actual injection execution remain pending.

decision: The complete two-file four-hunk patch replaces only the createNgModuleRef import and call identifier with createNgModule in private bottom-sheet and dialog module-bound fixtures. It preserves the module type, parent injector, resulting module injector and test assertions. The owned legacy dialog already imports/calls createNgModule with its parent injector and passes ngModuleRef.injector into its dialog open operation; no owned Core import of createNgModuleRef exists. Authenticated exact Core21.2.23/22.1.7 declarations expose createNgModule publicly without a deprecation tag. Record that narrow source adaptation as already present; no API, fixture, public bottom-sheet fork or consumer change follows. This does not qualify module lifetime, injection behavior, actual Angular or the supported floors.
